question: How many Indian beaches were awarded the prestigious 'Blue Flag certification' by an international jury in October 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Eight.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Eight Indian beaches have been awarded the prestigious 'Blue Flag certification by an International jury comprising members of the following organizations:
 
 
• The International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN)
 
• World Tourism Organization (UNWTO)
 
• United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP)
 
• Foundation for Environment Education (FEE).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The Blue Flag certification:**

 
 
• It is a certification that is given to a beach, marina, or sustainable boating tourism operator.
 
• It also serves as an eco-label.
 
• The certification indicates their high environmental and quality standards.
 
• It is awarded by the foundation for Environmental Education, an NGO based in Denmark.
 
• It was instituted in France in 1985 and for nations out of Europe in 2001.
